name: Error Recovery - API Timeout
modification: When API timeout occurs, implement retry mechanism with exponential backoff (max 3 retries, base delay 1s)

name: Error Recovery - Connection Refused
modification: When connection refused, add delay and retry logic with circuit breaker pattern

name: Error Recovery - Service Degradation
modification: When service unavailable, switch to cached data or fallback service

name: Optimization - Code Simplification
modification: Apply Karpathy Guidelines: simplify code, remove unnecessary abstractions, reduce lines by 50%

name: Optimization - Performance
modification: Profile code to identify bottlenecks, apply optimization techniques (caching, vectorization, parallelization)

name: Memory - Update Guidelines
modification: Extract key insights from session and update RULE.md or MEMORY.md with new guidelines

name: Innovation - Skill Enhancement
modification: Analyze skill usage patterns and propose enhancements or new skills
validation_command: python -c "import os; print('Skill enhancement validation OK')"

name: Reliability - Error Handling
modification: Add proper error handling with try-except blocks, input validation, and meaningful error messages
validation_command: python -c "try: x = {}['a']; except KeyError: print('Error handling OK')"

name: Reliability - Unicode Encoding
modification: Replace special Unicode characters with ASCII alternatives or ensure consistent UTF-8 encoding throughout scripts

name: Reliability - Empty List Handling
trigger_pattern: IndexError.*list index out of range|list index out of range
modification: Add length checks before accessing list indices; handle empty list cases gracefully
validation_command: python -c "lst = []; print('Empty' if not lst else lst[0])"

name: Optimization - Topic Boundary Correction
modification: Improve topic boundary detection using transition signals, intent consistency checks, and time interval analysis

name: Optimization - Intent Classification
modification: Expand intent categories and add more keywords to improve classification accuracy; add LLM-based semantic analysis

name: Reliability - Data Truncation
modification: Remove content truncation limits or increase buffer size to ensure complete data preservation

name: Reliability - Git Clone Error
trigger_pattern: git clone error|RPC failed|Connection was reset|request was aborted|cURL error
modification: Use --depth 1 for shallow clones, implement retry logic for network errors, or use alternative download methods
validation_command: python -c "import subprocess; result = subprocess.run(['git', '--version'], capture_output=True); print(result.returncode == 0)"

name: Reliability - Skill Not Found
modification: Implement fallback mechanisms when skills are unavailable; maintain skill registry with availability status
